review.tagline: Python library and CLI for training and running YOLO vision models
review.summary: Ultralytics provides the `ultralytics` Python package and `yolo` CLI for training, validating, predicting, tracking and exporting YOLO models. Tasks include detection, instance and semantic segmentation, depth estimation, classification, pose and oriented boxes. Pretrained YOLO26 weights download on first use, and models export to formats such as ONNX.
review.audience: Engineers building object detection and video analysis pipelines
strengths: One package and CLI cover train, val, predict, track and export across seven vision tasks
Pretrained YOLO26 n/s/m/l/x weights with published COCO mAP and CPU/T4 latency tables
Supports older YOLO versions back to YOLOv3, plus export to ONNX
Install via pip, Conda or Docker; docs in multiple languages
weaknesses: AGPL-3.0 license; commercial use needs a paid Enterprise License
Vision only; no LLM or language model support
Pretrained weights download from Ultralytics releases at first use
YOLO27 is announced but unavailable, with no launch date
needs: Models: YOLO26, YOLOv3, ONNX export, TensorRT export
